Package arztis.econnector.ihe

Class ElgaConnectionCaller

java.lang.Object
arztis.econnector.ihe.ElgaConnectionCaller
Direct Known Subclasses:
FhirElgaConnectionCaller
public class ElgaConnectionCaller extends Object
JAVA API for ELGA reference client. This class includes all function calls that are required for
  • Reading inserted card in card reader (e-card and Admin-Card - GINA)
  • User registration for ELGA and GINA
  • Patient contact confirmation with e-Card and bPK
  • Retrieving documents from ELGA and their eHealth applications such as electronic immunization record or virtual organizations
  • Posting and register documents in ELGA areas for different services such as electronic immunization record or eMedication
  • Canceling documents in ELGA areas for different services such as electronic immunization record or eMedication
  • Retrieving patient demographics
  • List and canceling patient contacts
This class is built as singleton, so you have to call getInstance() to instantiate.

      Returns:
      If the document was found, a list of Document is returned, otherwise an Message with the detailed error message is returned.
      Throws:
      Exception

    • registerPatientContact

      public Object registerPatientContact(ConnectionData connData, PatientContactParameter contactParameter, String ginoEndpoint) throws UnauthorizedException
      This method first retrieves card token form inserted e-Card. Afterwards identity assertion is requested by the SVC with the respective card token. The identity assertion is sent to all ELGA areas, which are enabled in the configuration file.
      Parameters:
      connData - Connection data of the respective user, who would like to insert the contact confirmation
      contactParameter - contains details like the used card reader to register the contact confirmation
      ginoEndpoint - endpoint of the GINO Service, it is required if the patient contact should be registered with eCard
      Returns:
      If the contact confirmation was successfully submitted, true is returned. Otherwise false or an error message Message is returned.
      Throws:
      UnauthorizedException - the unauthorized exception

    • registerUser

      public Object registerUser(ConnectionData connData, RegisterParam registerUserParam, String ginoEndpoint, Map<Integer,ElgaEHealthApplication> applications)
      This method first retrieves the card token form the inserted Admin-Card. Afterwards the identity assertion is requested by the SVC with the respective card token. With the identity assertion an HCP assertion is requested from ELGA. If a context assertion is needed for the ELGA application like for the electronic immunization record, the context assertion will be requested with the appropriate HCP assertion. All assertions are stored in the parameter connData.
      Parameters:
      connData - Connection data of the respective user, who would like to register the user
      registerUserParam - contains details for the user registration
      ginoEndpoint - endpoint for GINO (card reader). It is required if the user wants to register with an A-Card
      applications - ELGA eHealth applications for which the user should be registered. Possible keys are
      virtual organization 1
      electronic immunization record 2
      Returns:
      If the user was registered successfully, the filled connection data object connData is returned. If the registration failed, false or an error message Message is returned.

    • cancelDocument

      public RegistryResponseType cancelDocument(ConnectionData connData, String uniqueId, org.husky.common.model.Identificator patientId, String categoryCode, String authorInstitution, String oidTargetElgaArea) throws UnauthorizedException, ParserConfigurationException, SAXException, IOException, org.apache.xmlbeans.XmlException, AccessDeniedMessage, org.husky.xua.exceptions.DeserializeException
      This method cancels a document by setting the status of the document to deprecated. An ITI-57 transaction is executed in the background.

      connData - Connection data of the respective user who wants to cancel the document
      uniqueId - the unique id
      patientId - the patient id
      categoryCode - the category code
      authorInstitution - the author institution
      oidTargetElgaArea - OID of the ELGA area in which this document should be cancelled
      Returns:
      a message Message whether the cancellation was successful or why the request failed is returned.
      Throws:
      UnauthorizedException - the unauthorized exception
      ParserConfigurationException - the parser configuration exception
      SAXException - the SAX exception
      IOException - Signals that an I/O exception has occurred.
      org.apache.xmlbeans.XmlException - the xml exception
      AccessDeniedMessage - the access denied message
